title: US Institutional Bitcoin Custody Readiness Assessment
scope: Research pre-screen informed by US federal banking guidance and New York virtual-currency custody guidance. It is not a determination of compliance or legal advice.

requirements.label: Customer identity and due diligence
requirements.evidence_expected: Current KYC file, beneficial-owner record, risk rating, and approval record.

requirements.label: Legal authority and mandate
requirements.evidence_expected: Executed custody mandate plus current corporate, trust, estate, or court authority for the instructing persons.

requirements.label: Bitcoin asset and ledger risk assessment
requirements.evidence_expected: Approved Bitcoin-specific technical, operational, legal, compliance, and dependency assessment.

requirements.label: Control against unilateral transfer by another party
requirements.evidence_expected: Documented key ceremony and control test showing no outside party has information sufficient to transfer unilaterally.

requirements.label: Customer-asset segregation
requirements.evidence_expected: Wallet architecture and ledger records separating customer assets from custodian and affiliate assets.

requirements.label: Books, beneficial interests, and on-chain reconciliation
requirements.evidence_expected: Dated reconciliation tying on-chain balances to internal books and each customer's beneficial interest.

requirements.label: Key generation, storage, use, backup, and deletion controls
requirements.evidence_expected: Approved key-management standard, ceremony records, access matrix, backup inventory, and deletion procedure.

requirements.label: Tested loss, compromise, and continuity plans
requirements.evidence_expected: Recent recovery exercise and incident test with results, exceptions, owners, and remediation dates.

requirements.label: Cybersecurity control assessment
requirements.evidence_expected: Current security risk assessment covering custody systems, sensitive key material, access, monitoring, and incident response.

requirements.label: Sub-custodian and third-party due diligence
requirements.evidence_expected: Selection diligence, control assessment, insolvency analysis, service agreement, monitoring, and material-event notification terms.

requirements.label: Clear customer agreement, duties, and disclosures
requirements.evidence_expected: Executed agreement covering duties, instructions, storage model, fees, forks, disclosures, liability, and any sub-custody.

requirements.label: Current independent assurance or audit coverage
requirements.evidence_expected: Current independent audit or assurance work covering key lifecycle, transfers, settlement, IT, and third parties where applicable.
